steps.title: The Knight's Sword (XP skip)
steps.description: A free quest that gives a huge block of Smithing XP in one go: it skips most of the early smithing. You need to mine blurite ore (Mining 10).

steps.title: Smith at the Varrock anvil
steps.description: Use a hammer and a recipe matched to your level, usable bars and budget at the Varrock west-bank anvil. Time and net cost depend on the selected product and current prices.

steps.title: Anvil smithing
steps.description: Anvils use bars and a hammer; furnaces turn ores into bars. Follow the shared Skills plan for the selected activity. A one-bar dagger or three-bar warhammer can use leftovers that cannot make a five-bar platebody.

steps.title: Later anvil progression
steps.description: Check the actual recipe level: steel platebodies need 48, mithril daggers 50 and platebodies 68, adamant daggers 70 and platebodies 88. The shared planner compares feasible products and current material costs.

steps.title: Giants' Foundry
steps.description: Forge swords at Giants' Foundry: low effort, and it pays you. Needs Sleeping Giants.

steps.title: Blast Furnace gold bars
steps.description: Smelt gold bars at the Blast Furnace: the fastest viable members method from level 40 (it costs money).

steps.title: Smelting bars at Edgeville
steps.description: Use the shared furnace plan for the ores and coal you can actually use. Compare current input cost and sale value; profit is not guaranteed. Ordinary iron has 50% success; ring of forging and Blast Furnace bonuses are not assumed.

steps.title: Barronite deposits
steps.description: Crush deposits in Camdozaal after Below Ice Mountain: very slow, very calm.
